title: Forward test of the mirror / momentum theory on Voxelyze: split parity, mirrored patterns, frictionless heterogeneity
frozen_note: one 2-cycle smoke run (nx=5 longitudinal, dtScale 0.5) was used to check the build; it is not part of the results
why: post-hoc, stored runs suggest the 'longitudinal' drift is a body/pattern asymmetry from x < nx/2 integer division at odd nx. This is the forward test, with predictions written before running.
driver: engineering/xenomodel/voxel_parity/parity_actuation.cpp (copy of scripts/voxel_actuation/soft_actuation.cpp + longitudinal_mirror pattern + rhoFront + mass-weighted COM + per-cycle COM)
defaults: all scripts/voxel_actuation defaults (5x3x3 cross-section ny=nz=3, voxel 0.01 m, E 1e5 Pa, rho 1e3, nu 0.35, muS 1.0, muK 0.8, zetaInt 1, zetaGlob 0.1, zetaColl 0.8, cte 0.01, amp 10 C, 4 Hz, settle 0.25 s); measure 5.0 s = 20 cycles
metric: dbar = (COM_x at end of cycle 20 - COM_x at end of cycle 5)/15, mass-weighted COM, metres per cycle

predictions.P-V1: for every even nx in {4,6,8,10} and each dtScale: |dbar(nx)| < 0.1*|dbar(nx=5)| at the same dtScale
predictions.P-V1b: for odd nx in {5,7,9}: dbar has the same sign at both dtScales and |dbar| > 3*max over even nx of |dbar| at the same dtScale
predictions.P-V2: for nx in {5,7} at each dtScale: |dbar_mirror + dbar| <= |dbar(dt 0.5) - dbar(dt 0.25)| of the original pattern (the dt-refinement change)
predictions.P-V3a: V-C1: |net_dx| <= 1e-9 m for both patterns (uniform damping ratio, no friction)
predictions.P-V3b: V-C2: |net_dx| > 1e-6 m (non-uniform C/m = 2 zeta sqrt(E s/m) propels without friction)

falsifiers: P-V1 fails: symmetric-split bodies drift at the order of asymmetric ones -> a symmetry-breaking element (solver ordering, contact, multistability) is missing from the account
P-V2 fails: mirror endpoint fails -> anisotropy artifact in body construction or solver, or non-unique dynamics
P-V3a fails: contradicts the momentum theorem for the source force law
P-V3b fails: the damping-ratio hypothesis is not what makes the theorem hold (or the effect is below resolution)
cannot_establish: anything about tissue, cilia or a built construct
spatial convergence (voxel count is the variable under test here, at fixed voxel size; body length changes with nx)
